strings.text: The ruins of the Old People
We were told God had punished them for their pride.
strings.translation: On nous disait que Dieu les avait punis de leur orgueil.

strings.text: We were not allowed to come here. We came.
strings.translation: Il nous était défendu de venir ici. Nous venions.

strings.text: Sophie stroked the rusty side — warm from the sun.
strings.translation: Sophie caressait le flanc rouillé, tiède de soleil.
